_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/casting/test_cast_before_step.py. t_cbs_berserk carries cast_before_step 'combat_damage' on an instant -- Berserk's first line, with a bare draw as its payload so the tests measure the window and not the effect. t_cbs_free is the identical instant WITHOUT the restriction, kept live so every 'cannot be cast' assertion is measured against a card that can.

cards.name: Test Berserk Window
cards.oracle_text:
Cast this spell only before the combat damage step.
Draw a card.
